cues.en: Hello, everyone. Welcome to The Biggest Ideas in the Universe. I'm your host, Sean Carroll. This is the introductory video for what I hope is going to be a set of short, informal videos. Short, I don't really know, but informal, absolutely, about what I think are the biggest ideas in physics, in science, and the way that we understand the natural world in which we live. So the basic idea is going to be every week, I will try to produce one of these little videos where I pick a big idea, okay? Space.
cues.zh: 大家好，欢迎收看《宇宙大构想》。我是主持人 Sean Carroll。这是该系列的先导视频，我希望之后能做成一系列简短、随性的短片。短不短我还真不敢保证，但绝对会很随性；内容则是关于我认为在物理学、科学以及我们认识所处自然界的过程中，最宏大的那些构想。基本设想是每周我会尽量制作这样一支小视频，每次挑选一个大主题，比如：空间、

cues.en: force, time, something like that. And I talk about it in a way that hopefully is absolutely accessible to everybody. There's no prerequisites involved or anything like that. The concepts, the specific ideas that we get to will get pretty advanced as the series goes on.
cues.zh: 力、时间等等。我会用一种尽量让所有人都能听懂的方式来讲解。不需要任何预备知识或类似的基础。随着系列的推进，我们探讨的那些具体概念和构想确实会变得相当高深。

cues.en: But there's not going to be any need to be already a physics junkie or anything like that to really understand what we're talking about. It's supposed to be a way to help everyone out there think about the biggest ideas that we have when it comes to understanding our natural world. Now you might ask, why would I do this? For one thing,
cues.zh: 但即便你完全不是物理迷，也绝对能理解我们所聊的内容。它的初衷是想帮助大家一起思考，在理解自然界时人类所拥有的那些最宏大的构想。你可能会问，我为什么要这么做？一方面，

cues.en: don't I already have a day job? And I do. I'm a theoretical physicist at Caltech and the Santa Fe Institute. I also host a podcast, the Mindscape podcast, and I write books, most recently something called Something Deeply Hidden about quantum mechanics in many worlds. So I have a lot going on. But there's something new that has come in right now, of course, depending on when you are watching this, you are either well aware or may not know that we're in the early stages of the coronavirus or
cues.zh: 难道我没有本职工作吗？其实我有。我是加州理工学院和 Santa Fe Institute 的理论物理学家。我还主持一档名为 Mindscape 的播客，我也写书，最近的一本叫《Something Deeply Hidden》，讲的是量子力学和多世界诠释。所以我的事情其实很多。但最近发生了一件新鲜事，当然，这取决于你何时看到这个视频，你可能非常清楚，也可能不太了解，我们正处于冠状病毒或

cues.en: COVID-19 pandemic worldwide. It is right now March 19th, 2020. So we are just now beginning to take super duper seriously the need for things like staying at home, social distancing, a little bit of self-isolation or whatever you want to call it, ways to slow down the spread of this virus that currently we have no way of curing or vaccinating against. So...
cues.zh: COVID-19 全球大流行的初期阶段。现在是 2020 年 3 月 19 日。我们才刚刚开始极度重视居家、保持社交距离、适度自我隔离等等举措，或者随便你怎么称呼它，这些都是为了减缓病毒的传播，而目前我们既无法治愈它，也没有疫苗可用。所以……

cues.en: This is a spooky, surreal thing for a lot of people, myself included. Probably less so for someone like me who very often works at home and whose work is sort of...
cues.zh: 对很多人来说，包括我自己，这都让人感到不安甚至不真实。不过对于我这种经常在家工作、工作性质本身就偏向……

cues.en: inward focused from the start, but for a lot of people who work at regular jobs out there that might have shut down for the epidemic or people who are just extroverted and like to go out every night, this can be a really, really trying time. So all of us are looking for ways to both get through it ourselves and to sort of keep connections going with other people even if we can't actually go out to a restaurant or bar or concert or movies and hang with them.
cues.zh: 向内探索的人来说，感受可能还不算最强烈；但对于那些从事常规工作、如今单位可能因疫情关停的人，或者那些性格外向、每晚都喜欢出门社交的人来说，这可能是一段极其艰难的时期。因此，我们所有人都在寻找度过难关的办法，同时也希望即便无法再去餐厅、酒吧、音乐会或电影院聚会，依然能与彼此保持联系。

So I'm not going to be talking about that. I'm not going to pretend that my knowledge is in any way relevant to that. So after this introductory video, there's not going to be any more mentions of COVID-19, coronavirus, pandemics, anything like that.
cues.zh: 我能做点什么，以某种方式分享我掌握的知识，而且让大家觉得有意思。现在，我没有任何知识能对抗击大流行病有帮助，好吗？我做的这种物理，不是帮你理解病毒如何传播之类事情的那种物理。所以我不会讲那个。我也不会假装我的知识和那个有任何关系。所以在这期介绍视频之后，就不会再提到 COVID-19、冠状病毒、大流行病之类的东西了。

cues.en: But what I can do is talk about the physics that I do know and that I know that everyone likes a little bit, but maybe they haven't had time to catch up on some of the basics. So from my perspective, from my own peace of mind, rather than fretting about the spread of the virus, I get to work on this new project, but I also want it to be a little bit of a community interaction project.
cues.zh: 但我能做的是聊聊我确实懂的物理，我知道大家都多少喜欢一点，只是可能没时间补上一些基础。所以从我自己的角度，也为了让自己安心，与其担心病毒传播，不如来做这个新项目；不过我也想让它带点社区互动的性质。

cues.en: So what I'm going to do is after every single video, I will wait a couple days, I will let questions accumulate either on YouTube or on my blog or on Twitter or whatever. And then I will try to pick out some of the best questions and do another video addressing those questions. There's all sorts of different formats one can take for something like this, right? Like I thought about just teaching a high level course with all the equations and all that stuff.
cues.zh: 所以我打算每发一个视频后，等上几天，让问题在 YouTube、我的博客、Twitter 或其他地方积累起来。然后我会挑出一些最好的问题，再做一期视频来回答。这种事可以有很多不同形式，对吧？比如我也想过干脆教一门高阶课程，把所有方程和那些东西都讲一遍。

cues.en: But there's already good courses out there, and also it will be work. And I think that the fact that it's work does not bother me, but it would slow down the whole process. I wanted to dive into something that I could just do right away with minimal preparation. So if you're interested in the higher level stuff, I recommend you go to courses like edX or Coursera, where they have really, really good, high level, massive online courses. I love taking these courses. You can get everything all the way up to quantum field theory and particle physics there.
cues.zh: 但外面已经有很好的课程了，而且那也会很费工夫。我倒不介意费工夫，但那会拖慢整个过程。我想直接切入那种几乎不用准备、马上就能做的东西。所以如果你对更高阶的内容感兴趣，我建议你去 edX 或 Coursera 这样的课程平台，那里有非常非常好的高阶大规模在线课程。我很喜欢上这些课。你在那里可以一路学到量子场论和粒子物理。

So, of all the ways that we can continue to grow and flourish as human beings, what better way is there than to know and learn and understand just a little bit more about how the universe works? Hopefully we'll be able to provide that a little bit. Come back for the next video and we'll see how it goes.
cues.zh: 现在聚在一起变得非常非常困难，但通过互联网、借助科技彼此交流，是我们在几十年前做不到、而如今能够做到的事情，所以我们可以利用这一点。因此，在能让我们继续成长和蓬勃发展的各种途径中，还有什么能比多去探知、学习并理解一点宇宙的运行方式更好的方式呢？希望我们能带来一点这方面的启发。下期视频再见，看看后续会如何吧。
